payload.text: **Slot desk** (hv, 24 Oct 06:50Z; hv 25 Oct: the ONE host queue for every estate on rhadamanth and kovacs): molt-vc runs heavy/light contention across Molt, Intent, Laksa, Utilz, devbin, Conflab and Gtools. Rules: one heavy, plus one light while the 1-min load is under 60; one cargo run machine-wide, kovacs included; no .app/LS light beside an LS run; START/END by name; first READY first (security wins a tie); a fresh booking after a refused landing or a failed run takes its READY-time place; a node that hands back keeps its original place; every judge runs the critic per changed file, opening on a known positive per language from the same dir that must exit 1 (Swift's critic arms nothing until Intent 0648); a Swift green needs an executed count above zero; every bats run, single arms included, goes through the desk; worktrees in $TMPDIR (hv); message stamps only from a date -u read in an earlier call. The ledger is in the scratchpad, and its last 'QUEUE AT FOLD' line holds the order (fold 3 at 16:25Z: no new GOs until hv says continue).
